sections.title: Manor Skins
sections.blurb: Rebuild the Manor as something else entirely. Cosmetic only — it earns exactly what it earned before.

items.name: Mushroom Cottage
items.blurb: Grown, not built. The cap sheds ash the way a roof sheds rain.

items.name: The Old Windmill
items.blurb: It ground grain before the ash. The sails still catch the updraft.

items.name: Great Tree House
items.blurb: The isle kept one tree through the burning. Someone moved in.

items.name: The Igloo
items.blurb: Cut from Borealis ice, hauled south, and still not melting.

sections.title: Decorations
sections.blurb: Placed on the first free tile when you buy it. Purely yours — nothing merges with it. The landmarks at the end are monuments: they are meant to be seen from across the isle.

items.name: Ash Urn
items.blurb: The isle went to ash. Keeping some is how the line remembered.

items.name: Watch Bell
items.blurb: How a keeper called the dragons home. There were dragons then.

items.name: Rekindled Step
items.blurb: Moss through a cracked stair, gold in the fracture.

items.name: Chain Anchor
items.blurb: One cleat, one chain, one island held up. There are thousands.

items.name: Ice Lantern
items.blurb: A flame kept inside ice. Someone north of here does this.

items.name: Frozen Spill
items.blurb: A waterfall that stopped mid-fall and has not moved since.

items.name: Rune Pad
items.blurb: Moon-order line-work under snow. It still glows. Nobody lit it.

items.name: Drift Cairn
items.blurb: Stones, a float of green glass, a ribbon of woven light. A greeting.

items.name: The First Keeper
items.blurb: Carved while she was still alive, which she never forgave. The whelp at her feet is nobody anyone can name.

items.name: The Broken Gate
items.blurb: Everything that ever came home came through here. It has not closed since the burning, because it cannot.

items.name: The Ember Beacon
items.blurb: Lit at dusk, every dusk, for four hundred years. Nobody alive remembers what answered it.

items.name: The Elder's Rest
items.blurb: She came down here on purpose and let the ash take her. The moss got to her first.

items.name: The Tethered Isle
items.blurb: A stray the keepers caught and moored before it drifted off. One tree came with it.

sections.title: Dragons
sections.blurb: A dragon is still coaxed, never bought — but the ones already yours can be dressed in any breed the sanctuary has met. Cosmetic only: same eggs, same gifts, same wait.

items.name: Frost
items.blurb: Nested on the Borealis floes, scaled in clear ice, with the aurora burning through its wings.

items.name: Storm
items.blurb: It does not shelter from the thunderheads. It climbs the spire and answers them.

items.name: Moonwhisker
items.blurb: The Moonhold's own — all trailing ribbons and starlight, and far too shy to land near you.

items.name: Ashglass
items.blurb: A night down in the caldera. Its scales cooled to black glass and the fire never went out.

items.name: Porcelain
items.blurb: Glazed like a temple vase, painted in cobalt, and mended with gold where it once broke.

sections.title: Keepers
sections.blurb: Who stands on your isle, and what they wear while they do it.
